verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an error-status workflow for triaging the error inbox (raygun-docs-25). It covers marking errors 'Resolved' (raygun-docs-10) and ignoring them with conditions. Those conditions include ignoring for a specific time period, which works as a snooze, plus by number of occurrences or by rule (raygun-docs-11, raygun-docs-26). However, nothing in the pack shows assigning an owner, and nothing confirms that a resolved issue reopens automatically when it regresses; the deployment-tracking claim about spotting regressions (raygun-docs-31) is adjacent, not auto-reopen. Missing for 10: assign-owner capability, documented automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression, independent or hands-on corroboration.
